text:
maria: Heads-up — production saw a ~2.8x p99 latency spike on long-context requests around 21:12 UTC. Traced to KV cache evictions switching to FIFO fallback under sustained pressure.

 tj: ugh. repro? which model/seq?

 maria: small stress harness attached: ./tools/kv_stress.py --model llama-13b --concurrency 200 --seq 8192 --duration 5m. Repro is reliable in staging when we push concurrency >150.

 anita: can you paste the profiler / perf counters?

 maria: perf dump (summarized):
 ```
 eviction_policy: FIFO (fallback)
 kv_evictions: 12432 -> spike at t+90s
 kv_reuse_rate: dropped 0.72 -> 0.18
 mem_frag_ratio: 1.37 -> 1.82
 lock_wait_ms_per_op: 0.1 -> 4.6
 cpu (service): +22% sys
 stack: runtime/kv_cache.cpp:evict_batch -> runtime/pager.cpp:page_out -> mem/alloc.cpp:free_chunk
 ```

 sam: looks like fallback FIFO is evicting recently used keys -> more recompute & higher token generation cost. The lock_wait jump suggests LRU maintenance couldn't keep up.

 jia: we merged a change last week to switch LRU lists to chunked-append (PR #2147) to reduce pointer churn. That makes the LRU update path batched; if the batch flush is delayed under load we may hit fallback.

 tj: did kernel selection / quantization PR roll out too? different memory layout can increase fragmentation and make free/alloc slower.

 maria: yep — kernel-selector PR #2210 rolled three days ago. Timing matches the onset of noise in mem_frag_ratio.

 anita: proposed mitigation: 1) force conservative_lru_mode on all nodes (no FIFO fallback) 2) increase LRU update worker threads 3) add observability metrics: eviction_policy, evict_batch_size, per-shard_lock_wait, kv_reuse_rate, fragmentation_ratio.

 maria: opening revert PRs: reverting #2147 (LRU chunking) from canary and gating #2210 rollout. Also adding reproducer to CI with our harness.

 tj: also add a unit test for correctness under pressure: ensure eviction doesn't reorder newest keys incorrectly. We saw a failing trace where a hot key was evicted twice within same request window.

 anita: agree — add a fakeremote test that simulates contention and asserts kv_reuse_rate stays >0.5 for steady workloads.

 maria: temporary hotfix: enabled conservative_lru_mode for dedicated clusters and increased lru_flush_interval to 50ms. Early staging run shows p99 back to baseline.

 ops-bot: deploy job started for config: conservative_lru_mode=true, lru_flush_interval_ms=50 — job id deploy/1791234.

 sam: after fixes let's run a long-context soak (12h) to watch mem growth and fragmentation; short runs miss slow leaks.

 maria: agreed — scheduling overnight soak on staging and pushing metric dashboard for fragmentation + eviction policy switches. I'll post results tomorrow AM. :pray:

 tj: thanks. filing perf postmortem and action items.

 anita: adding follow-ups: rollback plan, canary gating, metrics alert thresholds (eviction_rate > 500/s or fragmentation_ratio > 1.5 triggers paging alert).

 maria: ping me if you see any further spikes, I'll keep the thread updated.
